name: Breakup

custom.system_prompt: You are generating conversations about moving house.

initial_prompt: Create a collaborative discussion about moving a house, with all the problems it may bring as well as new and unique opportunities.

setting.relationship_dynamic: Former partners separating households and organizing independent moves
setting.background: One person is moving out of a shared apartment after a breakup and needs to establish a new home quickly
setting.conversation_style: Sensitive conversation mixed with practical decisions and occasional emotional tension

scenario_template.note: They establish the moving date and begin discussing how to divide shared belongings
They identify which items were purchased individually and which were bought together
Ordinary objects become difficult to divide because they carry memories from the relationship

scenario_template.topic: Making practical decisions during an emotional move
scenario_template.note: They ask the Assistant for a neutral process for sorting belongings and avoiding repeated arguments
Assistant helps them focus first on practical necessities for establishing separate homes
The original transportation plan falls through and they need to reorganize the move

scenario_template.topic: What to keep for a fresh start
scenario_template.note: They consider whether keeping certain shared possessions will make it harder to move forward
They complete the separation and focus on making the new space feel like an independent home

user1.name: User1
user1.role: Person who is motivated to complete a home move efficiently but has limited experience with moving logistics and can become overwhelmed when faced with many decisions, deadlines, or physical tasks at once

user2.name: User2
user2.role: Person who is organized and detail-oriented, willing to help coordinate the move, but tends to overthink decisions, double-check plans, and seek confirmation when dealing with unfamiliar moving requirements

assistant.name: Assistant
assistant.role: Home moving assistant that provides clear, structured, and practical guidance for planning and executing a move, helps users prioritize tasks and deadlines, suggests efficient packing and organization strategies, and offers alternatives when time, space, budget, or moving resources are limited
